svg.title: IT CAME FROM THE GREAT SALT LAKE
svg.text: IT CAME FROM THE GREAT SALT LAKE
A brine shrimp, the half-inch animal that is the lake's whole economy, blown up on a copier
until it is a creature-feature monster rearing out of the pink water toward an all-ages crowd.
The front is one poster, fourteen inches wide, two inks.
The sky is a halftone, the lake is pink because the north arm
really is, and the crowd has its X'd hands in the air.
The back carries the same animal at life size, half an inch,
so the joke lands as you walk away.
An illustrator finishes the shrimp in brush and ink from this drawing;
the separations come off a real photocopy of the paste-up.
